build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone from detectron2 config with specified depth, norm, and deformable conv options
create_basicblock: create a BasicBlock residual layer with two 3x3 convolutions and optional projection shortcut for ResNet-18/34
create_bottleneckblock: create a BottleneckBlock residual layer with 1x1, 3x3, 1x1 convolutions and optional projection shortcut for ResNet-50+
create_deformbottleneckblock: create a DeformBottleneckBlock with deformable convolution in the 3x3 layer supporting modulated or unmodulated modes
make_resnet_stage: make a ResNet stage by calling ResNet.make_stage with a block class, number of blocks, and per-block stride or dilation
